name: -v
--volume
options.description: Set the volume for playback of the file Apple does not define a value range for this, but it appears to accept 0=silent, 1=normal (default) and then up to…

name: -t
--time
options.description: Play for `TIME` seconds >0 and < duration of `audio_file`

args.name: TIME
args.description: A value greater than 0 but lower than the audio file length

name: -r
--rate
options.description: Play at playback `RATE`. practical limits are about 0.4 (slower) to 3.0 (faster)

name: -q
--rQuality
options.description: Set the quality used for rate-scaled playback (default is 0 - low quality, 1 - high quality)

args.name: play the song in the path
